DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (Shy-Drager Syndrome)

The combination of autonomic dysfunction (orthostatic hypotension, incontinence), parkinsonian features (rigidity, tremor), and cerebellar signs (gait ataxia, slurred speech) is highly characteristic of this condition. Have you noticed any changes in your sexual function or sweating patterns?
